page.title: Permissions
page.description: Every action this app knows about, read-only.
page.glossaryAriaLabel: What do Action, Resource type, Destructive and Held by mean?

action.definition: One specific allowed operation, like "delete a user", the thing that actually decides access whether it comes from a policy or is granted directly.

resourceType.definition: What kind of thing an action acts on, like "users" or "invoices", used to group and filter this catalog.

destructive.definition: An action that deletes, deactivates, or otherwise changes something in a way that's hard to undo.

heldBy.definition: Who currently has this action, either through a policy they hold or granted straight to their account.

page.failedToLoadPermissions: Failed to load the permission catalog
page.catalogForbidden: This permission catalog is no longer available because your permission changed. Refresh the page or return to the dashboard.

page.holderInfoForbiddenTitle: Holder information is no longer available
page.holderInfoForbiddenDescription: Your permission to view holder information changed. Refresh the page or close this dialog.
